cohort: Term, singleton, breech neonates delivered at Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar from May 2012 to April 2013.
finding: Vaginally delivered breech babies had a higher incidence and severity of DDH compared to those delivered by elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: DDH was more common and severe in vaginally delivered breech babies compared to those delivered by elective cesarean section.
